entries.subject: Karkoschka (2001) adopted Voyager/HST shape
entries.finding: Table IV of the HST study supplies the adopted prolate semiaxes 75 × 37 × 37 km. The repeated minor axis is a model assumption, not an independently measured third dimension. French et al. (2024), Table 3 reproduces the separate Voyager size paper’s projected-radius and axis-ratio uncertainties; they are not individual-axis errors. The selected analytic shape supplies no local relief or surface pixels.

entries.subject: PDS Voyager ISS, calibrated/geometrically corrected images
entries.finding: Sorted 3,441 indexed Juliet observations by body-center sampling. Best C2673225 is 46.28754 km per native pixel, about 3.2 samples along the longest possible diameter. Downloaded and inspected the 1000×1000 GEOMED raster and label: geometric resampling cannot add native surface detail. Its 15.36 s exposure and 5:1 scan also limit an inferred footprint. Excluded as a photographic surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: A Juliet observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: French 2024 occultation analysis
entries.finding: Included for shape uncertainty and orbital context; no spatial surface field.

entries.subject: HST photometry and Keck near-infrared photometry
entries.finding: Integrated brightness/color measurements cannot supply resolved surface texels. No separate Color or composition map qualified.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved Juliet measurement supplies original spectral or image samples with body-fixed coordinates and enough coverage to qualify a mapped lens.

entries.subject: JPL texture catalog, PDS shape releases and USGS mapping survey
entries.finding: No usable registered Juliet texture, detailed mesh, elevation or geology product located. Absence from the inspected catalogs is not a claim that no future dataset can exist.
entries.revisitWhen: The inspected shape archive or a cited primary release publishes a Juliet-specific numerical model with its frame, units and reconstruction method.
